title: Observation draft text/evidence kind persist across step switches; stale prose recordable as another step's S-029 evidence
notes: Partially fixed — remaining part per 2026-09-29 re-check: Main defect fixed in a5801b30: VerificationCoachPanel.tsx:128-135 now resets observationText and evidenceKind on requestKey change (test at VerificationCoachPanel.test.tsx:353). The secondary instance the finding names is still present: DecisionGate.tsx:59 `useState("")` riskReason is never reset or keyed per step; StepDetailSlideIn.tsx:1075 renders DecisionGate without a key, StepDetailSlideIn is mounted without a key (ProductShellLayout.tsx:216), and VerificationReviewStepper keeps activeStageId across stage-list changes (VerificationReviewStepper.tsx:53-60), so a risk reason typed for step A remains filled in for step B when the decision stage is active at the switch.
repro: Open step A review, go to decision stage, type accept-risk reason, switch rail to step B (also in review): reason textarea is still filled with step A's text.
